name: nifty_banknifty_spread_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: BANK NIFTY carries ~33% weight in NIFTY 50, creating a tight but imperfect correlation. The intraday return spread between BANK NIFTY and NIFTY 50 exhibits mean-reverting behavior around a slowly drifting mean. When BANK NIFTY outperforms NIFTY 50 by > 30 bps intraday (or vice versa), the spread tends to compress over the next few minutes. We trade the spread via index options: if BANKNIFTY is lagging and expected to catch up, BUY_CE on BANKNIFTY; if BANKNIFTY has overshot, BUY_PE on BANKNIFTY. The inefficiency exists because: (1) BANK NIFTY is the most traded F&O instrument and attracts speculative overreaction, (2) passive index funds rebalance toward NIFTY 50 weights, creating a natural reversion mechanism, (3) the spread is only mean-reverting intraday -- overnight the spread can shift permanently based on macro factors.

conditions: nb_spread_zscore < -1.5 (NIFTY outperforming BANK NIFTY -- expect BANK NIFTY catch-up)
spread_velocity < -3 (spread still widening -- wait for it to slow)
nb_spread_zscore > 1.5 (BANK NIFTY outperforming NIFTY -- expect compression)

entry.entry_price: market order on BANKNIFTY ATM CE/PE

exit.stop_loss: nb_spread_zscore extends to +/-2.5 (spread diverging beyond threshold)
exit.time_stop: exit after 24 bars (120 seconds) if target not reached
exit.signal_exit: India_VIX spikes > 22 during trade (correlation structure may break)

risk.position_sizing: fixed 1 lot BANKNIFTY options per signal

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 20; in high VIX, BANK NIFTY drops faster (higher beta) and spread may not revert
filters.time_filter: no trades in first 60 bars (5 min) or last 120 bars (10 min)
filters.volume_filter: both index option chains trading at > 0.8x normal volume
filters.trend_filter: skip if NIFTY 50 intraday move > 1.5% (strong trend makes spread directional, not mean-reverting)
filters.event_filter: skip on RBI policy day (banking-specific), budget day, F&O expiry
other_filters: skip if HDFC Bank/ICICI Bank have results today (distorts BANK NIFTY)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low -- NIFTY/BANK NIFTY spread mean reversion is structural due to the weight overlap and passive fund rebalancing. This trade has been viable for years in Indian markets.

mechanism: At 5-second frequency, the NIFTY-BANKNIFTY spread exhibits micro mean-reversion that is invisible on 1-minute charts. When BANKNIFTY drops relative to NIFTY by >30 bps, the spread_velocity (measured over 60 five-second bars = 5 min) detects the moment when the divergence is decelerating. Buying BANKNIFTY CE at this inflection captures the initial spread compression. The 5s resolution provides ~20-40 seconds of lead time versus 1-minute detection, which is significant because BANKNIFTY ATM options have high gamma and delta, so the first 20 seconds of spread compression translate to measurable premium gains. Single-leg option execution (vs. dual-leg futures) also reduces execution risk and margin requirements.
adaptation_notes: Adapted from 1-min dual-leg index futures spread to 5-sec single-leg index option strategy. Key changes: (1) Universe remains NIFTY/BANKNIFTY but execution changed from dual-leg futures to single-leg BANKNIFTY options (BUY_CE for spread catch-up, BUY_PE for spread compression), (2) Spread z-score lookback adjusted from 45 bars to 540 bars (equivalent 45 min at 5s), (3) Spread velocity adjusted from 5 bars to 60 bars (equivalent 5 min at 5s), (4) Time filter adjusted from 15 min / 10 min to 60 bars / 120 bars, (5) Hold time compressed from 20-60 min to 5-120 seconds, (6) Removed need for two-leg futures execution -- using BANKNIFTY options as the directional expression of the spread view, (7) Entry/exit now reference option premium (BUY_CE/BUY_PE) instead of paired futures positions.
weaknesses: On RBI policy days or banking-specific regulatory events, BANK NIFTY diverges from NIFTY permanently intraday. The stop loss at z-score +/-2.5 gets hit on such days.
Single-leg option execution captures spread compression imperfectly -- if NIFTY drops while BANKNIFTY is flat, the spread compresses but BUY_CE on BANKNIFTY doesn't profit.
The beta-adjustment ratio between BANK NIFTY and NIFTY is time-varying (1.2-1.5) and the z-score thresholds may need dynamic adjustment.
prior_art: Vidyamurthy (2004) 'Pairs Trading: Quantitative Methods and Analysis'. Elliot, van der Hoek & Malcolm (2005) 'Pairs Trading'. In India, the NIFTY/BANK NIFTY spread is widely discussed but typically traded on daily charts, not intraday at 5-second frequency.
notes: Adapted for 5-second BANKNIFTY index option trading. Consider monitoring both legs but executing only on BANKNIFTY options for simplicity and lower execution risk.
